ma.closeSocket(Object object)

Close a WebSocket connection.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
code Number 1000 (indicating that the connection is closed normally) No A numeric value representing the status number of the closed connection, indicating the reason why the connection is closed.
reason String No A readable string, indicating the reason why the connection is closed. This string must be UTF-8 text (not characters) no longer than 123 bytes.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

    ma.connectSocket({
       url: 'wss://example.huawei.com',
    })
    // Pay attention to the time sequence.
    // If ma.closeSocket is called first before ma.connectSocket calls back ma.onSocketOpen, the WebSocket connection cannot be closed.
    // The WebSocket connection can be closed only when ma.closeSocket is called when the WebSocket connection is being opened.
    ma.onSocketOpen(funtion() {
      ma.closeSocket()
    })
    
    ma.onSocketClose(function(res) {
      console.log('WebSocket connection closed!')
    })
